title: 高油价下：美国消费者储蓄缓冲消失，还能撑多久？
speaker: Herman Chan

segments.en: So Herman, I do want to start with you, and when we talk about the banks, we often talk about, what moves the company's stock?
segments.zh: 赫尔曼，我们先从你开始。谈到银行，我们常关注什么推动公司股价？

segments.en: I'm not interested in that right now. I'm interested in what consumers are telling the banks that they're doing in a higher energy prices environment and a higher inflation environment.
segments.zh: 我现在不关心这个。我更想知道，在能源价格和通胀上升的环境下，消费者向银行透露了什么信息。

segments.en: These are the companies that see what we're spending our money on at that exact moment. What are they going to tell us?
segments.zh: 这些银行能实时看到我们的消费动向。他们会告诉我们什么？

segments.en: So, they're going to tell you that they're spending more on gas prices at the pump over the past month or so. That's going to be front and center when they talk about the consumers.
segments.zh: 他们会告诉你，过去一个月消费者在加油上花了更多钱。这将是他们谈论消费者时的重点。

segments.en: I think you're also going to hear about a resilient economy because we're still seeing a lot of GDP growth still chugging along. But there is going to be the question, are the higher energy prices going to create some cracks in the consumer side?
segments.zh: 你还会听到关于经济韧性的讨论，因为GDP增长仍在继续。但问题是，能源价格上涨是否会在消费端造成裂痕？

segments.en: Well, I think the challenge between this conversation that we're having now versus what the conversation that we had about this in 2022, what the last time we saw inflation like this, was consumers still had that cushion post-pandemic. That's not still there.
segments.zh: 我认为，与2022年上次通胀时相比，现在的挑战在于，疫情后消费者曾有的缓冲垫已不复存在。

segments.en: So, the savings rates are much lower than they were and you don't have the sort of stimulus that was propping up the consumer back then. So, there are some questions on where things are going to go going forward but we'll hear more about that over the next few weeks because that's going to be front and center for earnings across the board.
segments.zh: 储蓄率远低于以往，也没有当时的刺激措施支撑消费。未来走向存在疑问，但未来几周我们将了解更多，因为这将是各行业财报的重点。
